product.what: Theorem itself, recorded with film/capture/capture.mjs against the local demo stack. Two real model turns, once, at capture. Nothing goes through a model when the page loads.
product.note: The film plays the recording faster than life to fit its length: the typing and both answers are sped up. Nothing on screen is staged or edited. The development overlay, which a production build does not have, is hidden in the capture.

motion.reference: A 15.1 s story ad by softriver.co for taap.it, supplied as a screen recording: one mark held dead centre while the picture cuts behind it, from 100 ms slowing to 400 ms and beyond, with a colourway change.
motion.taken: The idea of a registered mark over speed-ramped cuts. None of its assets.
motion.safety: The fast cuts stay on one side of the luminance range and the colourway changes only once they slow, which keeps the film under three flashes in any second. evidence/oracles/film.mjs measures it.
